summary: Steep east kerb at the street's bend; homes 13-24 m away, narrow lane.
reasons: Narrow lane, one car parks here

best_section.where: South end of Glasnevin Street east kerb, beside the shaded verge

drivers.seclusion: Nearest dwellings 13-24 m from this section; a non-residential building sits 6 m away; homes across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed narrow street; a car is parked at the east kerb at the north end, so there is room for one van, with little spare width.
drivers.convention: Signed 4P parking, Mon-Fri 9am-4pm; nothing restricts evenings or overnight.

flags: Dwellings 13-24 m away on the street's own side
Brisbane River 191 m away, low ground about 30 m
sun_shade: Tree canopy over the south end; open to the morning sun and shaded by trees in the afternoon.
